text:
emma: heads-up — found a leaked credential in Sentry from a old test run. looks like it was a long-lived service account key stored in plaintext in a tmp log file.

liam: oh no. which service?

emma: edge-proxy-test (not the prod proxy). log shows `API_KEY=eyJhbGci...` and it appears in a few deploys dating back 3 months. i grep'd the repo history and it's from an abandoned script.

sanya: any evidence it was used externally?

emma: no confirmed external use yet — logs show only internal CI IPs. still treat as compromised.

raj: ok, plan: 1) revoke the key 2) rotate any dependent secrets 3) run a scan for other plaintext secrets 4) add KV/vault-backed secrets + KMS envelope encryption if missing.

liam: i'll revoke the SA key now and push a short rotation ticket. doing `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable <KEY_ID>` then delete.

emma: thanks. note: edge-proxy-test is configured to read secrets from Vault in prod, but this test env used an env var blob. we should ensure tests are required to use the same Vault shim.

sanya: can someone confirm where that env var came from? CI logs point to `ci-runner-3` injecting it from a file `/secrets/tmp-creds.txt`. looks like a manual step by someone months ago.

raj: we need to coordinate a rotation window so nothing breaks. liam — after revoking the SA key, list all services that use that SA and set owners to notify.

liam: running `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=edge-proxy-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com` now. also adding owners: @emma @sanya.

vault-bot: detected: secret path `secret/test/edge-proxy` has plain text fallback entries. Recommend migration to `kv-v2` with KMS envelope encryption.

emma: good catch. we should also enable audit logging on Vault and KMS for the test project so we can trace any reads during rotation.

sanya: I can add audit sinks — will enable Vault audit (file) and Cloud KMS audit logs to logging bucket `redwood-audit-dev`. ETA 30m.

raj: while that happens, liam can you create a temporary token for the replaced credential and validate CI job runs against it? we want to confirm no hard-coded tokens remain in pipeline configs.

liam: creating token and running a targeted CI run for edge-proxy-test. also kicking off a repo scan using `git-secrets` and `truffleHog` for the last 2 years.

emma: put the repo-scan output into `#eng-security` when done. if anything else pops up, we'll do emergency rotation.

liam: quick results: git-secrets flagged 4 matches (all false positives except one in `scripts/dev/local/run.sh`). i'm rotating that one too.

vault-bot: reminder: rotate any KMS-wrapped keys using `gcloud kms keys versions create` followed by re-encrypting secrets.

sanya: confirmation: Vault audit enabled, bucket configured, and I set retention to 90 days.

raj: next steps and owners:
- revoke compromised SA key (liam)
- rotate any dependent secrets and re-wrap with KMS (liam + sanya)
- scan repos and CI configs for plaintext creds (liam)
- migrate test envs to Vault-backed secrets and enforce through CI (emma + sanya)
- add alert for new plaintext uploads to `tmp` folders in CI (emma)

emma: i'll open a short runbook for emergency rotation steps and link it in the ticket. include commands below so on-call can act fast:
```
# disable and delete compromised key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable <KEY_ID> --iam-account=edge-proxy-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete <KEY_ID> --iam-account=edge-proxy-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
\n# rotate KMS-wrapped key
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=edge-proxy-key --location=global --keyring=prod-kr
# re-encrypt payloads (example)
echo $PLAINTEXT | gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=prod-kr --key=edge-proxy-key --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | base64
\n# revoke Vault tokens
vault token revoke -self
```

liam: ran the revoke and deleted the key. CI job passed with new temporary token. i also replaced the local file in the test runner with a Vault client that reads from `secret/data/test/edge-proxy`.

emma: nice. can we also add an automated check in CI that fails the run if it finds any `API_KEY=` or `SECRET_` patterns in created artifacts?

raj: yes — add a `preflight` job that runs `truffleHog` and `grep -E "(API_KEY|SECRET_|passwd=)"` over build artifacts; fail fast. assign to @emma.

emma: added the CI preflight MR — PTAL @liam @sanya. if green we'll merge and enforce on branch protection.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for `ci-runner-3` with new secrets shim.

sanya: merged and audit logs show the KMS rewrap events. everything looks clean.

emma: closing action: i'll file a short post-incident note and tag compliance. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
